Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Maltol is the flavouring compound 3-hydroxy-2-methyl-4H-pyran-4-one. It is a white crystalline material associated with a sweet, caramel-like aroma. Its food purpose is flavouring rather than providing the bulk sweetness of sugar. FDA lists maltol among synthetic flavouring substances, used at the minimum amount needed for the intended effect.
